Repositories

All InTraC software on GitHub

All InTraC software is developed openly on GitHub. Below is an overview of the main repositories maintained by Z01.

Repository Description Status
intrac-workflows Nextflow/nf-core pipeline configurations 🟢 Active
intrac-knowledgebase Data management platform & omics database 🟡 In development
intrac-platform LLM-powered interactive multi-omics analysis 🟡 In development
intrac-training Course materials, tutorials & workshops 🟢 Active
ℹ️
Contributing

InTraC researchers are encouraged to contribute to all repositories. See the CONTRIBUTING guide in each repository for details on how to submit issues and pull requests.

GitHub Organisation

Visit github.com/InTraC-CRC1784 to see all repositories, including project-specific tools and analysis scripts contributed by individual research groups.
